name: Altima – Auto Add ALT Text to Images
author: Umar Jameel

sections.description:
Generate image alternative text, description, and captions automatically. Boost your website’s SEO, accessibility, and image visibility automatically with Smart Image SEO. This powerful plugin intelligently generates ALT text, image captions, and descriptions for all your images, saving time while improving your rankings in WordPress and search engines like Google.

🚀 Perfect for:
– Bloggers
– Agencies
– SEO professionals
– eCommerce stores

Features

  • Automatically add ALT text on image upload
  • Generate captions and descriptions
  • Use image filename for SEO-friendly text
  • Optional prefix (e.g. website name or brand)
  • Bulk update existing images
  • Skip images that already have ALT text
  • Option to replace existing ALT text
  • Control maximum text length
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Install and activate the plugin
  3. Go to “Smart Image SEO” in dashboard
  4. Choose your settings
  5. Upload images OR run bulk update
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any API?

No. Everything works locally. No API or signup required.

Will it overwrite existing ALT text?

Only if you enable the “Replace Existing ALT” option.

Can I process old images?

Yes. Use the “Bulk Update Existing Images” button.

Is it beginner friendly?

Yes. Simple UI, no technical setup needed.
